phase_name: Classify the Markdown Duplicate-Block Inventory and Declare NET-MD

objectives.description: Re-run script-inventory.sh --size-line and confirm the markdown corpus figure against the Phase 1 baseline
Re-derive the cross-file duplicated-block inventory (5-line shingling) and record the per-role table
Emit the gate-required exclusion list mechanically from lint-agent-contracts.sh and lint-postflight-boundary.sh
Emit the deliberate-inlining exclusion list (email extension; check for other adopters)
For each remaining eligible block, record the durable anchor; mark anchor-less blocks not eligible
Write the eligible inventory to markdown-block-inventory.tsv
Declare the confirmed NET-MD target and its per-tranche allocation, or record a shortfall as a user_decision
Widen file_scope from the inventory via update-task-status.sh --file-scope-add
Record the phase's NET-MD delta (zero by construction)

approaches_tried.approach: Per-line-presence anchor test (any 3-of-5 window lines independently present anywhere in a candidate anchor file)
approaches_tried.reason: Produced large false positives: 399 semantically unrelated windows all anchored to one large reference file via coincidental matches on common short lines (code fences, generic Stage headings), unrelated to actual content ownership.

approaches_tried.approach: Exact-5-gram anchor test (the window must literally recur as a contiguous run inside the anchor file, i.e. the anchor file is itself one of the window's sharing participants)
approaches_tried.reason: Eliminated the false-positive class; found 197 of 3,359 eligible windows (26 distinct anchors, 933 net removable lines) genuinely anchor-backed. Flagged in the plan as likely a conservative undercount of true (semantic) anchor coverage.

deviations.description: Widen file_scope from the inventory before any tranche runs, via update-task-status.sh --file-scope-add
deviations.reason: --file-scope-add is restricted to operation==postflight && target_status in {research, plan}; this phase runs mid-implement, so the script refused the call. Used a direct, minimal, additive-only file_scope edit to specs/state.json instead, per state-management.md's sanctioned manual fallback.
